1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora silvestre, perenne, de hasta 6 m de altura, con muchas espinas diminutas y con pequeñas flores de color blanco o lila pálido. (Asteraceae, Chromolaena odorata).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Wild, perennial climbing plant, reaching up to 6 meters in height, with numerous small spines and small white or pale lilac flowers. (Asteraceae, Chromolaena odorata).
